questions.question: On this day in 1707, the very first Parliament of Great Britain convened following the unification of England and which other kingdom?
questions.explanation: The Parliament of Great Britain was established in 1707 when the Acts of Union merged the kingdoms of England and Scotland.
questions.context:
On this day in 1707: The First Parliament of the Kingdom of Great Britain convenes.
First Parliament of Great Britain (Parliament of the Kingdom of Great Britain from 1707 to 1708): The first Parliament of the Kingdom of Great Britain was established in 1707 after the merger of the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland.

questions.question: In the 2026 DC Studios psychological thriller Clayface, which actor portrays the title role of Matt Hagen?
questions.explanation: Tom Rhys Harries stars as Matt Hagen, also known as Clayface, in the 2026 film directed by James Watkins.
questions.context: Clayface (film) (2026 DC Studios film): Clayface is a 2026 American body horror psychological thriller film based on the eponymous character from DC Comics. Directed by James Watkins from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, it is the third film in the DC Universe (DCU). Tom Rhys Harries stars as Matt Hagen / Clayface, alongside Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella, and Eddie Marsan.

questions.question: Which rock music superstar was model and actress Jerry Hall in a long-term partnership with, having four children together?
questions.explanation: Jerry Hall had a long-term relationship with Rolling Stones frontman Mick Jagger before her later marriage to Rupert Murdoch.
questions.context: Jerry Hall (American model and actress (born 1956)): Jerry Faye Hall is an American model and actress. She began modeling in the 1970s and became one of the most sought-after models in the world. She transitioned into acting, appearing in the 1989 film Batman. Hall was the long-term partner of Rolling Stones frontman Mick Jagger, with whom she has four children. She was the fourth wife of Rupert Murdoch until they divorced in 2022.

questions.question: Filmmaker Mike Flanagan developed a 2026 supernatural horror television series for Amazon Prime Video based on which author's debut 1974 novel?
questions.explanation: Flanagan adapted Stephen King's 1974 debut novel Carrie into a television series for Amazon Prime Video.
questions.context: Carrie (TV series) (2026 television series by Mike Flanagan): Carrie is an American supernatural horror television series developed by Mike Flanagan, and produced by Amazon MGM Studios for Amazon Prime Video. The first series adaptation of the eponymous franchise, it is based on the 1974 novel by Stephen King, and is the fourth screen adaptation of the novel.

questions.question: Originally standing for 'Personal Home Page', what does the popular web scripting language PHP now recursively stand for?
questions.explanation: The scripting language created by Rasmus Lerdorf evolved from standing for 'Personal Home Page' into the recursive backronym 'PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor'.
questions.context: PHP (Scripting language created in 1994): PHP is a general-purpose scripting language geared toward web development. It was created by Danish-Canadian programmer Rasmus Lerdorf in 1993 and released in 1995. The PHP reference implementation is now produced by the PHP Group. PHP was originally an abbreviation of "Personal Home Page", but it now stands for the recursive backronym "PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor".
